description: Street trees (render-only), one per line: [treeid, x, z, class, height m]. class indexes `classes`. Placed from San Francisco Public Works' Street Tree Inventory; height from trunk diameter (pipeline/lib/street-trees.ts). Ids for knockable props: tree:<treeid>.
